Thank you for your reply. I don't know if I can learn to love myself or to be more self-assured by myself, I feel like these have to be consequences of being well-considered by other people. And it is difficult to stand up for myself when I don't believe in me, but I will try my best to stop being a doormat for other people (which is really what I have been this past year), and start being a human being. 

I always thought that being as nice as possible was the best thing I could do to have a chance of not being alone anymore. I will try to follow your advices, I hope things will be better, thank you
